scope: alpha-next queue (arm table, arms, grade, numerics, STOP_RACE, arm loop, derived texts) hub CPU tests; no box or GPU evidence

leaves.name: arm-control-replies
leaves.replaces: The engine control client replies to native_progress, native_qsa_fused, native_layer_group, native_stage_local and release_auto_arm
leaves.equivalence: The question is what the arm does with each reply: order, resume on refusal, refusal of a reply that does not prove the selection. The reply fields are the real ones; test_alpha_next_queue.Arm reads the same fields through the real endpoint, session and driver.

leaves.name: arm-http-no-scheduler
leaves.replaces: A served engine: the HTTP prompts reach no scheduler, so no native chunk runs
leaves.equivalence: The question is which typed controls, in which order, the exact arm command line sends through two real NativeRuntimeClients, the real endpoint, session, control client and startup-bound stack (C0's StagedSegmentDriver, fused QSA, layer groups), and which temperature the greedy streams' request bodies carry. As in Step B's and C0's Arm.
leaves.cannot_prove: A real chunk under any selection (the box runs that)

leaves.name: test-scale-workloads
leaves.replaces: The band manifests sizes and times
leaves.equivalence: Only sizes and times are reduced, as held-f's workload() does; the cohort (8 standing decoders), the salts and the manifest choice are the real ones.
leaves.cannot_prove: A 65,445- or 131,094-token prompt end to end

leaves.name: grade-synthetic-run
leaves.replaces: A real box run: arm records with spans, fused, group and stage counters, outputs and the engine log those spans select
leaves.equivalence: Progress lines come from the real nm.ProgressTrace emitters through AlphaEmit (Step B's group commands, C0's per-stage reply pattern, the stage line with headroom_blocked_ns as stage_progress logs it); memory and memory-peak receipts in the engine's formats.
leaves.cannot_prove: The real speed, decode ratio, memory, peak or numerics

leaves.name: greedy-token-ids
leaves.replaces: The greedy standing streams' first 256 token ids as the arm records them
leaves.equivalence: Synthetic id lists with declared common prefixes; the envelope arithmetic is the question, not the ids.
leaves.cannot_prove: Whether C0 changes greedy outputs on the box

leaves.name: stop-race-lines
leaves.replaces: The engine log at the queue stop
leaves.equivalence: Verbatim stop lines of q18a-step-b-e (2 Nov) and q18a-native26 (30 Oct) with their stop intents; negatives are those lines edited one declared way each.
leaves.cannot_prove: A stop race in an alpha-next run

leaves.name: arm-loop-clients
leaves.replaces: The arm client (e3_alpha_next_box arm), the check client (e3_native39_trunk_checks), nvidia-smi, docker and systemctl
leaves.equivalence: Stubs that copy prepared records and log their argv; the body, the draft functions, the death watch, the grade and the read are real, under real bash.

leaves.name: arm-loop-clock
leaves.replaces: The run's elapsed time at an entry limit
leaves.equivalence: bash SECONDS (relative, writable) is set past a limit right after a named step; the budget is the gate's relative LAST_ARM_ENTRY_S and LAST_TAIL_ENTRY_S. No real clock is read.
